pslist: Flag suspicious when process name appears random or known malware-like
Flag suspicious when parent-child relation is unusual for system processes
If cmd.exe, vssadmin.exe, or vssvc.exe is spawned by a suspicious parent, flag as suspicious
Do not flag allowlisted system processes solely because of RWX VAD without corroboration
vadinfo: Treat PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE as supporting evidence; require malfind MZ/shellcode or suspicious lineage/path before flagging
malfind: Increase suspicion when memory region contains MZ header or shellcode-like bytes
cmdline: Flag system-named processes that run from non-system paths or have suspicious command-line arguments
Treat vssadmin delete/shadow copy removal commands as strong ransomware signals
